name: Minamiaizu (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Minamiaizu town emblem in blue, orange and green: three curved strokes in blue, orange and green forming a stylised letter Z.
history: Municipal flag of Minamiaizu, a town in Fukushima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 20 July 2006.

features.role: Minamiaizu town emblem — three curved strokes in blue, orange and green forming a stylised letter Z
